data.name: Nicarius
data.gender_notes: Nicarius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Nicolaos, which comes from the Greek nikos, meaning victory or conqueror. The name Nicarius was borne by several early Christian saints, including Saint Nicarius of Reims and Saint Nicarius of Calama. The name Nicarius carries the meaning “Victor, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Nicarius usually hope their child will grow to embody victor, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing victory in spiritual battles and overcoming adversity.
data.etymology: Nicarius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victor, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicarius total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: ניקריוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ניקריוס מקורו ביוונית ונגזר מהמילה 'ניקא', שפירושה 'נצחון'. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם מייצג את נצחון האל על החטא והמוות, והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה של תקווה והישועה. השם ניקריוס משמש כתזכורת לנוכחות האלוהית בחייו של המאמין.

in_greek.name: Νικάριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νικάριος προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'νίκη', που σημαίνει 'νίκη' ή 'θρίαμβος'. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη νίκη του Θεού ενάντια στο κακό και το θάνατο. Ο Νικάριος θεωρείται όνομα που φέρνει ευλογία και προστασία από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Nicarius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nicarius originates from the Greek word 'nike', meaning 'victory'. In Christian tradition, Nicarius signifies the triumph of God over sin and death. This name holds a profound spiritual significance, representing the power of faith and divine protection.

in_english.name: Nicarius
in_english.meaning: Victory of God, God is my champion
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nicarius is derived from the Greek roots 'nike' (victory) and 'arios' (champion or warrior). In Christian context, Nicarius represents the triumph of God's will and the believer's reliance on divine strength. Historically, the name may be linked to early Christian martyrs and saints who embodied spiritual victory.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nicarius carries the historical significance of early Christian martyrs and saints, evoking a sense of bravery and resilience in the face of persecution. It is a reminder of the rich history and legacy of the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nicarius signifies the ultimate victory over sin and Death that is granted through faith in Christ. It is a name that invites us to remember the power of God's love and grace to overcome all obstacles, even those that may seem insurmountable. As a Christian name, Nicarius calls us to live our lives with faith, courage, and a deep sense of trust in God's providence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nicarius, meaning "victorious," is a name that symbolizes the triumph of faith and the spirit over worldly struggles and adversities. It is a reminder of the ultimate victory that awaits the faithful in Christ.

historical_references.reference: Nicarius is mentioned as a prefect of the city of Rome during the reign of Emperor Julian in AD 362. He was known for his strong Christian faith and was persecuted by Julian for it.

Nicarius is also mentioned in the Acts of the Martyrs of Abitinae, which recounts the story of the Christian martyrs Felicissimus, Agape, and Agatha. Nicarius, who was a high-ranking military officer, is said to have played a key role in their arrest and eventual martyrdom during the reign of Emperor Maximian in the late 3rd century AD.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nicarius is of Roman origin and is found in Christian hagiography as the name of a martyr who lived during the late 3rd or early 4th century AD. In modern times, the name Nicarius has seen a resurgence in various contexts. On Reddit, there are several subreddits dedicated to Roman history and Christianity, where Nicarius is discussed as a historical and religious figure. On Steam, there is a game called 'Nicarius: The Last Hope' which is set in a fictional universe inspired by Roman history and features a character named Nicarius. On Wikipedia, Nicarius is the subject of a detailed entry in the online encyclopedia, providing information about his life, martyrdom, and significance in Christian history.
